results.title: Authentication - Plain Docs
results.snippet: Authentication Create a machine user and an API key, and scope it with fine-grained permissions. A machine user can have several API keys, so you can rotate them without downtime. Each API key carries its own fine-grained permissions. To call the API as a user in your workspace, use an OAuth app.
